definitions.explanation: Describes walking or moving at a fast pace. Often implies purpose or urgency in one's movement.

examples.japanese: {足早|あしばや}に⟦{立|た}ち{去|さ}った→立ち去る：04640_tachisaru⟧。
⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}って→降る：00839_furu⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{足早|あしばや}に⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: Since it started raining, I headed briskly toward the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{言|い}わ→言う：00515_iu⟧ず、{足早|あしばや}に⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れた→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧。
examples.english: Without saying anything, she hurriedly left the scene.

notes:
USAGE:
Typically used with verbs of movement such as ⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (walk), ⟦{去|さ}る→去る：02115_saru⟧ (leave), ⟦{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎる→通り過ぎる：02372_toorisugiru⟧ (pass by), ⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧ (head toward). The adverbial ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is essential — ⟦{足早|あしばや}→足早：14454_ashibaya⟧ alone functions as a na-adjective or noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {足早|あしばや}に⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (walk briskly)
- {足早|あしばや}に⟦{立|た}ち{去|さ}る→立ち去る：04640_tachisaru⟧ (leave hurriedly)
- {足早|あしばや}に⟦{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎる→通り過ぎる：02372_toorisugiru⟧ (pass by quickly)
- {足早|あしばや}に⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧ (head somewhere briskly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧: hurriedly — more general; can apply to any action, not just walking
- ⟦{早足|はやあし}→早足：21118_hayaashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: at a fast pace — similar meaning but used as a noun with で
